## Purpose 
<!--- One sentence to describe the purpose of this PR, refer to any linked issues:
#14 -- this will link to issue 14
Closes #2 -- this will automatically close issue 2 on PR merge
-->
- Closes #578 

## Content
<!---  specific tasks that are currently complete 
- Solution implemented
-->
- divide loss by the scale of the problem represented as `\sigma_c` in constrained gaussian
- ensure \sigma_c > 0
- update the warning to a correct "two-sided" bound issue (as the one-sided bound warning is not the right thing to check)

## Example

New behaviour:
```julia
julia> d = constrained_gaussian("q", 1.8e-4, 0.6e-4, 0.0, 1e-3)
ParameterDistribution with 1 entry
  'q': Parameterized (Normal) [1 constraint]
julia> c = transform_unconstrained_to_constrained(d, sample(MersenneTwister(1), d, 200_000))
1×200000 Matrix{Float64}:
 0.000164505  0.000235929  0.000132357  0.000107353  …  0.000218431  0.000186153  0.000170233
julia> mean(c), std(c)   
(0.00018015236640330962, 6.0056736504487256e-5) # within tight relative tolerance
```
Before these were `~(5.0e-4, 2.1e-4)`
